name: chirp-dictation
description: Offline push-to-talk dictation for Windows and Linux X11

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run native && electron .
scripts.start:linux: npm run build && sh scripts/native-linux.sh && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run models && npm run native && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run models && sh scripts/native-linux.sh && npm run build && electron-builder --linux tar.gz --x64 --config.compression=store
scripts.test:paste: npm run build && scripts\native.cmd test && electron tests/paste-smoke.cjs

author: Chirp
